intro: Cleveland's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $110/month, up 3.8% from a year earlier (StorageCafe, September 2026). Storage Stats puts the Cleveland metro non-climate 10x10 asking rent at $112, down 5.4% from a year earlier (October 28, 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $117. The advertised rate on this page averages the published figures above. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); no StorageUnitCosts city page; Oct 2026 (Storage Stats metro)

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $43 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$46.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $66 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$72. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $110, up 3.8% from a year earlier (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). Storage Stats Cleveland metro non-climate asking rent $112, down 5.4% from a year earlier (updated Oct 28, 2026). That figure covers the metro, not Cleveland alone. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$117.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $148 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$152.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $174 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$202.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Ohio City (~$112), Detroit-Shoreway (~$114), Downtown Cleveland (~$115) among the cheaper areas for a standard unit. Old Brooklyn (~$267) is among the highest.
Cleveland has about 28 facilities and 2.3 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
